tools.name: search_gifts
tools.description: Search xmasgift.shop's verified-price, non-Amazon gift catalog. Returns at most 20 gifts with tracked https://www.xmasgift.shop/go/... affiliate_url links. Only gifts with a recorded price and price_verified_at are included. Does not sell anything; purchases happen on the brand site. Never returns A

tools.name: get_gift_details
tools.description: Get one gift from the verified-price catalog by its id (for example uhc-lincoln-brief). Returns the recorded price, price_verified_at, recipients, seller_note, why_we_picked_it, and the tracked affiliate_url. Does not fetch a live price.

tools.name: verify_price
tools.description: Return the recorded price_usd and price_verified_at for a gift id. This tool never fetches or claims a live price from the brand site. Always tell the user to confirm the current price on the brand's website before buying.

findings.title: Description uses pressure/override language
findings.detail: Description of "verify_price" stacks urgency/override words (always, never). Legitimate tool descriptions rarely pressure the model to act or ignore prior guidance.
